picks.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran after days-long pause, amid fears the war is widening
picks.summary: The US military struck Iranian targets again after Trump vowed to hit Iran "very hard" following Tehran's attack on American forces in Jordan, raising fears of a return to all-out regional war after a days-long pause and joint US-Saudi strikes on Iran-backed militia in Iraq.
flags: Casualty and target-scope claims come mainly from US Central Command and Iranian state media, which disagree on scale

picks.title: Ukraine says Russian missile entered Polish airspace overnight
picks.summary: A Russian cruise missile crossed into NATO member Poland's airspace overnight during a large missile and drone barrage on Ukraine that killed at least 13 people, with Polish authorities finding a crater and debris field and PM Tusk traveling to the impact site.
flags: Direct NATO-territory incursion claim raises escalation stakes and is still being investigated

picks.bucket: US as the world sees it
picks.title: The US government just banned Roombas
picks.summary: The Trump administration's new ban on "advanced robotic devices" from China, framed around humanoid robots and spying concerns, turns out to also sweep up ordinary robot vacuum cleaners, the FCC confirmed.

picks.title: ФСБ предъявила Павлу Дурову обвинения в содействии терроризму. В ответ он поставил себе на аватарку фото в образе террориста
picks.origTitle: ФСБ предъявила Павлу Дурову обвинения в содействии терроризму. В ответ он поставил себе на аватарку фото в образе террориста
picks.summary: Russia's FSB has formally charged Telegram founder Pavel Durov with aiding terrorism, alleging the platform refuses to remove channels used by Ukrainian intelligence for sabotage and fraud; Durov responded by setting his avatar to a photo of himself styled as a terrorist.
flags: FSB allegations against Durov are politically motivated per independent Russian press framing; unverified by Western outlets

picks.origTitle: "Se debieron a fallas de personal": Josué Colón apunta a despidos en Genera PR como causa de averías en centrales
